alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins (500 µg) were reduced by 10 mM DTT at 56°C for 45 min and alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide in the dark for 30 min at room temperature.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins (500 µg) were reduced by 10 mM DTT at 56°C for 45 min and alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide in the dark for 30 min at room temperature.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The solutions were diluted eightfold in 40 mM ammonium bicarbonate, and sequencing grade trypsin was added to the solution at 1:40 (w/w), followed by incubation overnight at 37°C.

collision_energy.evidence: The parameters were as follows: resolution of 60,000, collision energy of 35% for HCD, 5% for stepped collision, AGC target 5 × 104, maximum injection time 150 ms, and microscan 1.

enrichment_method.evidence: Glycopeptides were enriched from the incubated mixture by Oasis MAX extraction cartridges (Waters), lyophilized by speed vac, and resuspended in 2% ACN/0.1% formic acid buffer.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Secondary mass spectrometry analysis was then performed using the data dependent HCD fragmentation pattern.

labeling.evidence: inferred: For mass spectrometry (MS) analysis, 2 µg glycopeptides were applied to an EASY-nLC 1200 system (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA, USA) equipped with an internal RSLC C18 column (75 µm × 25 cm).

ptm.evidence: modifications: N-linked glycan core N4-glycosylated asparagine
